Forme juridique de l'attributaire Le marché public sera conclu : – soit avec un opérateur économique unique ; 8/17 – soit avec un groupement d’opérateurs économiques conjoint ou solidaire. En cas de groupement conjoint, le mandataire sera solidaire, pour l'exécution du marché public, de chacun des membres du groupement, pour ses obligations contractuelles à l'égard de l’acheteur. La composition du groupement ne peut être modifiée entre la remise des offres et la date de signature du contrat. 2-6. ant indiquant qu'il ne tombe pas sous le coup d'une interdiction de soumissionner. Pour satisfaire aux obligations susmentionnées, le candidat qui envisage, dès le dépôt de son offre, de sous-traiter une partie de sa prestation, complètera utilement la déclaration de sous - traitance et joindra, pour chaque sous-traitant, l’ensemble des documents, attestations et renseignements réclamés aux candidats, tels que figurant au présent règlement de la consultation. La notification du marché public emporte acceptation du sous-traitant et agrément des conditions de paiement. Les prestations de services sont prouvées par des attestations du destinataire ou, à défaut, par une déclaration de l'opérateur économique ; • Une déclaration indiquant les effectifs moyens annuels du candidat et l'importance du personnel d'encadrement pendant les trois dernières années ; • Une description de l'outillage, du matériel et de l'équipement technique dont le candidat disposera pour la réalisation du marché public. Es wird erwartet, dass sämtliche Maßnahmen zur Unterstützung der Datenschutzfolgeabschätzung durch den Beauftragten durchgeführt werden. Insbesondere sind die im Verfahrensverzeichnis aufzunehmenden verfahrensbe- zogenen Angaben zur Verfügung zu stellen (vgl. Art. 30 DS-GVO). Daher werden die aktuellen techni- schen und organisatorischen Maßnahmen des Anbieters angefordert. Im Verfahren werden regelmäßig personenbezogene Daten verarbeitet. Die Zulässigkeit der Verarbeitung personenbezogener Daten richtet sich nach den einschlägigen datenschutzrechtlichen Vorschriften. Vor der Entscheidung über den Einsatz e

en datenschutzrechtlichen Vorschriften. Vor der Entscheidung über den Einsatz eines automatisierten Verfahrens sind ggf. im Rahmen einer Daten- schutzfolgeabschätzung (Art. 35 DS-GVO), die die zur Bewältigung der Risiken geplanten Abhilfemaß- nahmen, einschließlich Garantien, Sicherheitsvorkehrungen und Verfahren, durch die der Schutz perso- nenbezogener Daten sichergestellt durch den Verantwortlichen zu dokumentieren. Dies bildet den Nach- weis über die Einhaltung der DSGVO. Die IT- und TK-Verantwortung obliegt innerhalb der Stadt Essen der eigenbetriebsähnlichen Einrichtung „Essener Systemhaus“. Das Essener Systemhaus ist zertifiziert nach ISO 27001. Our strategy sets a clear pathway to achieve net zero emissions in a way that supports our customers and ensures ESB’s continued growth. ESB are committed to leading the transition to a reliable and affordable net zero future. ESB seeks to purchase supplies, services and works that are produced or delivered in a manner that has the most positive environmental, social and economic impacts possible over their entire lifecycle. ESB procurement processes will be aligned with the standards from ISO20400, Sustainable Procurement. ESB have created a Sustainability Leadership Plan which sets out our ambitions and the actions we will take as they relate to the three pillars of sustainability - People, Planet and Place. Full details of ESB’s Sustainability Leadership Plan can be viewed here: ESB Sustainable Leadership Plan. ESB requires that the successful Contractor emerging from the Procurement process be familiar with our Sustainable Leadership Plan. ESB is a founding member of the Irish Supply Chain Sustainability School. The school’s aim is to support and develop skills and knowledge in sustainability in the built environment. Further

The successful tenderer will be required to work collaboratively with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and stakeholders to design, develop, review, test and deliver digital learning content from initial onboarding through to final approval and provision of SCORM-compliant outputs. The supplier will be expected to provide a structured and transparent development methodology, supported by appropriate governance, project management, universal design principles including accessibility, quality assurance and stakeholder engagement processes. It is proposed that the Framework will include (non-exhaustive list – high level scope): Create engaging, accessible and effective digital learning that keeps learner needs, content and learning objectives central to the design. Examples of digital learning topics and types include: Policy, process or compliance learning Systems, technical or operational training Bite-sized learning, such as microlearning, video or animation Develop digital learning materials using the ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation and Evaluation) framework, ensuring learning objectives, activities and assessmen

ing objectives, activities and assessments align with Bloom’s Taxonomy and the needs of the target audience. Use purposeful interactive approaches to enhance learner engagement. Apply Universal Design for Learning (UDL) and accessibility-by-design principles throughout, ensuring compliance with WCAG 2.2, EN 301 549 and ESB accessibility requirements, and meeting accessibility best practices. Ensure all interactive elements are accessible, usable and support diverse learner needs, undertaking additional development where required to meet accessibility requirements. Undertake accessibility testing as part of the design, development and quality assurance process, using appropriate testing methods and tools, and remediate identified accessibility issues prior to final delivery and approval. Provide appropriate coaching, guidance and instructional design support to SMEs within the business. In addition, ESB extracts further value at certain points along this chain: supplying gas, using our networks to carry fibre for telecommunications, developing electric vehicle public charging infrastructure and more. Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. Revenue requires a platform for 200 users that provides access to relevant, high -quality learning content on current technologies and industry practices. The platform should have a clear, intuitive catalogue that enables users to easily search for and access relevant learning materia ls. The provider must ensure that content is regularly reviewed and updated to reflect developments in technology and industry practices.
